explication: MeshCore Open is a cross-platform Flutter client for communicating over MeshCore LoRa radios. The primary workflow is to connect to a radio, synchronize mesh data, then message a contact or broadcast in a channel; users also manage routing, repeaters, maps, and device settings. The graph combines those documented product capabilities with a storage layer and Android USB bridge visible in the source tree. Dart implementation details were not sampled, so most relationships are documented at README level rather than verified as source calls.
